title: robotsix-browser configuration
description: Runtime configuration for the robotsix-browser service. Values are supplied as ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_* environment variables (secrets are provisioned via the deploy EnvStore as masked container env vars).

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_HOST.title: Bind host
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_HOST.description: Interface the HTTP API binds to.

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_PORT.title: Bind port
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_PORT.description: TCP port the HTTP API listens on.

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_FILE_HUB_BASE_URL.title: file-hub base URL
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_FILE_HUB_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the robotsix-file-hub service used by the upload endpoint.

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_HEADLESS.title: Headless Chromium
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_HEADLESS.description: Launch Chromium headless. Always true in production; overridable in dev.

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Default action timeout (ms)
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Default action timeout in milliseconds for page interactions.

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_SERVER_URL.title: Vaultwarden server URL
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_SERVER_URL.description: Vaultwarden server URL (Vaultwarden speaks the Bitwarden API). Required for the credential-fill endpoint.

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_CLIENT_ID.title: Vaultwarden API-key client_id
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_CLIENT_ID.description: API-key client_id for the dedicated service account (user.<uuid>).

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Vaultwarden API-key client_secret
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_CLIENT_SECRET.description: API-key client_secret for the dedicated service account. Masked; never echoed, logged, or returned.

ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_COLLECTION_ID.title: Vaultwarden collection id
ROBOTSIX_BROWSER_BW_COLLECTION_ID.description: The single collection id the service is scoped to. Any entry outside this collection is rejected.
